roles.evidence: Schlegel USA: U.S. business establishment; go-to-market focused on intralogistics, mobile machinery and vehicles. CV industry overview names warehouse automation and mobility; the company is a manufacturer of HMI components. Functional evidence: US business leadership, market entry, GTM, operating model, cash/profitability planning and custom CRM/ERP development.

INTUTEC: U.S. market entry, sales development and digital distribution solutions for industrial and automation companies; Schlegel USA reference project. Functional evidence: founder/CEO, US market entry, sales networks, digital operating workflows and implemented distribution platform.

CAPTRON North America: built and led U.S. subsidiary; manufacturer of capacitive and optical sensors and signal indicators. Do not infer other countries solely from North America or additional industries from customer brand names. Functional evidence: subsidiary leadership, revenue scaling, strategic accounts, localized supply chain, OKRs/profitability and custom business software. Imported live role explicitly names warehouse automation and transportation.

CAPTRON business development: CV explicitly names distribution partners in the U.S., Mexico, Canada, Australia and India; go-to-market approaches for traffic & transport, industrial automation and building technology. Functional evidence: market development, distribution/OEM sales and structured partner-management processes. Imported live description explicitly adds warehouse automation.

User confirmed on 2026-11-10 that Korea means South Korea (KR). Functional evidence: FICE establishment, China entry, OEM/Tier-1 sales, team/process buildout and internal workflow system. No standalone software-development claim inferred.
Both CVs identify operational leadership in China; imported English record is now MENTOR only. General management and operations apply; no precise served industry inferred.

German CV: international procurement, supplier management and local business relationships. Imported live record explicitly identifies procurement and business activities in China. No product industry specified.
